# Test issuegraph init command
issuegraph init --prefix test
stdout 'initialized successfully'
exists .issuegraph/issuegraph.db
exists .issuegraph/metadata.json
exists .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^\*\.db$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^\*\.db-journal$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^\*\.db-wal$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^\*\.db-shm$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^daemon\.log$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^daemon\.pid$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^issuegraph\.sock$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^!\*\.jsonl$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^!metadata\.json$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
grep '^!config\.json$' .issuegraph/.gitignore
